404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: Invalid/revoked API key, including a key belonging to a closed account (INVALID_API_KEY).

403.description: API key scope/restriction denial (SCOPE_DENIED) or plan capability entitlement missing (PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED).

429.description: Project minute quota, expensive-operation budget, free-account monthly quota, or paid billing-period quota exhausted at the Worker gateway (RATE_LIMITED, MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, PERIOD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, or EXPENSIVE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED). Origin rate limits may also return this status.

RateLimit.description: Remaining shared project allowance and window reset.

RateLimit-Policy.description: Project minute and calendar-month quota policies and window lengths in seconds.

503.description: Worker project quota admission unavailable (QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE), or credential/account status unavailable (ACCOUNT_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE); retry after the indicated delay.

204.description: High-risk tarpit: normally delayed 3–5 seconds, with no response body. X-Egdata-Mitigation: tarpit distinguishes mitigation from ordinary no-content responses. Always private/no-store; do not treat as catalog data, automatically retry, or start PoW. Retry manually later. The per-process sleeper cap can omit the delay under saturation.

descriptions.gateway-quota: When accessed through the Worker gateway with an API key, this operation consumes the project's shared UTC-aligned 60-second quota across all keys, console sessions, and legacy/v1 gateway requests (commercial plans: Free 60/min & 100,000/UTC calendar month shared across free projects; Pro EUR 9/mo VAT-incl 200/min & 300,000/billing period; Scale EUR 19/mo VAT-incl 600/min & 1,000,000/billing period; explicit manual/grandfathered/enterprise grants preserve their approved bounds), alongside explicit expensive-operation minute and period budgets. Plan entitlements are evaluated independently from API key scopes before cache lookup or quota debit; missing capabilities return 403 PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED. Cache hits and conditional 304 responses count toward admitted requests; upstream 5xx failures keep the minute counter consumed while crediting back the monthly/period unit idempotently. Minute/operation exhaustion returns 429 RATE_LIMITED; free monthly exhaustion returns 429 MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED; paid period exhaustion returns 429 PERIOD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED; expensive period budget exhaustion returns 429 EXPENSIVE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, each with Retry-After until reset; unavailable admission returns 503 QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After: 1. Gateway errors use { error: { code, message } }. Unauthenticated public health/spec bypasses and CORS preflights skip quota accounting, while legacy routes require an API key or a trusted first-party credential. Account closure rejects all account keys, including warm credential caches, with 401 INVALID_API_KEY before quota or response-cache access. Failure to verify credential/account status returns 503 ACCOUNT_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After: 30. Initial dashboard email/terms onboarding does not pause existing API keys, even after a dashboard visit.
descriptions.protected-read: When ANTI_ABUSE_MODE=enforce, clients with current risk <= 0.5 can request data without a PoW session. Only suspicious clients (0.5 < risk <= 0.8) require a valid session less than 30 seconds old; missing, invalid, or expired sessions return SESSION_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED with HTTP 200. Clients can solve PoW on demand and retry once. Scores above 0.8 receive a 3–5 second delay and HTTP 204 No Content with X-Egdata-Mitigation: tarpit regardless of session. Historical token scores do not prevent recovery after current risk clears. Normal responses retain existing cache policies and ETags; challenges, bodyless tarpits and canary lists are private/no-store. Baseline rate limits remain active and can return 429. Cloudflare cache hits bypass origin scoring and require separate edge controls. Existing account authentication requirements still apply. In observe mode an operator can apply the same policy to exact trusted fingerprints on offer-detail or catalog-search routes for an expiring trial of at most 15 minutes. Catalog search and sandbox-offer pagination contribute traversal evidence, grouped by normalized filters; ordinary isolated queries remain low-risk.
